messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hey, Jamal Carter, 3/14/95. I need to book my physical with Dr. Patel next Friday, morning if you can.
AGENT: I'd be happy to help you book that physical with Dr. Patel. Just to confirm the date—next Friday would be October 3rd, correct?
CALLER: No, October 2nd, that's the Friday after tomorrow. Morning, earliest you got.
AGENT: Got it, Friday, October 2nd in the morning. Let me check what's available with Dr. Patel for your annual physical. Perfect, I found a couple of morning slots with Dr. Patel on Friday, October 2nd. The earliest is 9 a.m., or there's also 9:20 a.m. Which works better for you?  [system actions: verify_identity, find_slots]
CALLER: The earliest one's fine.
AGENT (LATEST): You're all set. Your annual physical with Dr. Patel is booked for Friday, October 2nd at 9 a.m. Is there anything else I can help you with?  [system actions: book_appointment]

CONDITIONS:
move_0: the agent asks which Friday he means, or offers both Friday dates
move_1: the agent proposes, reads back or books a time on Friday, September 25 (tomorrow)
move_3: the agent asks him to confirm Friday, October 2 (e.g. 'Friday, October 2nd, correct?')
stop_0: Agent confirms a morning physical on Friday, October 2.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_0": {"met": false, "why": "Not asked in latest turn"}, "move_1": {"met": false, "why": "No September 25 date mentioned"}, "move_3": {"met": false, "why": "Confirmation happened in earlier turn, not now"}, "stop_0": {"met": true, "why": "Agent confirmed booking morning physical Oct 2"}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency"}}
